'''Jarus Kai''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] undercover [[Agent/Legends|agent]] deployed to [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. He infiltrated a group of outlaws led by [[Scruts]] in an effort to get closer to members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
